CREATE TABLE `cl_tree_cloud_managed_operation` (
  `key` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `operation_id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `operator_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `cloud_account_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `cloud_account_region_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `resource_ids` text,
  `kind` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `admission_version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `started_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `claim_token` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `request_hash` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `state` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `result` text,
  `reviewed_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reviewed_by` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `review_reason` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `previous_state` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`key`),
  KEY `idx_cl_tree_cloud_managed_operation_operator_id` (`operator_id`),
  KEY `idx_cl_tree_cloud_managed_operation_cloud_account_id` (`cloud_account_id`),
  KEY `idx_managed_op_scope` (`cloud_account_id`,`cloud_account_region_id`,`kind`,`created_at`),
  KEY `idx_cl_tree_cloud_managed_operation_cloud_account_region_id` (`cloud_account_region_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `cl_tree_cloud_managed_resource` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键ID',
  `created_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '创建时间',
  `updated_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '更新时间',
  `deleted_at` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '删除时间',
  `cloud_account_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `cloud_account_region_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `kind` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `provider_id` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `rds` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `clb` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `cache` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `local_description` text,
  `last_sync_time` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_managed_identity` (`cloud_account_id`,`cloud_account_region_id`,`kind`,`provider_id`),
  KEY `idx_cl_tree_cloud_managed_resource_deleted_at` (`deleted_at`),
  KEY `idx_cl_tree_cloud_managed_resource_cloud_account_id` (`cloud_account_id`),
  KEY `idx_cl_tree_cloud_managed_resource_cloud_account_region_id` (`cloud_account_region_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `cl_tree_cloud_managed_sync_history` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT '主键ID',
  `created_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '创建时间',
  `updated_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '更新时间',
  `deleted_at` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '删除时间',
  `cloud_account_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `cloud_account_region_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `kind` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `resource_ids` text NOT NULL,
  `client_operation_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `operation_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `lease_expires_ms` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `count` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `new_count` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `update_count` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `error_category` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `operator_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `started_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `finished_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `resolved_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `resolved_by` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `resolution_reason` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_cl_tree_cloud_managed_sync_history_deleted_at` (`deleted_at`),
  KEY `idx_cl_tree_cloud_managed_sync_history_cloud_account_id` (`cloud_account_id`),
  KEY `idx_cl_tree_cloud_managed_sync_history_cloud_account_region_id` (`cloud_account_region_id`),
  KEY `idx_cl_tree_cloud_managed_sync_history_client_operation_id` (`client_operation_id`),
  KEY `idx_cl_tree_cloud_managed_sync_history_operation_id` (`operation_id`),
  KEY `idx_cl_tree_cloud_managed_sync_history_status` (`status`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `cl_tree_cloud_sync_lease` (
  `region_id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `token` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `generation` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `expires_epoch_ms` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`region_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `cl_workorder_inbox_message` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `event_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `notification_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `user_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `instance_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `event_type` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `subject` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `read_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `deleted_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_inbox_delivery` (`event_id`,`notification_id`,`user_id`),
  KEY `idx_cl_workorder_inbox_message_event_id` (`event_id`),
  KEY `idx_inbox_user_deleted` (`user_id`,`deleted_at`),
  KEY `idx_cl_workorder_inbox_message_read_at` (`read_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `cl_workorder_notification_clock` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `time_zone` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `cl_workorder_notification_delivery` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `event_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `notification_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `channel` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `recipient_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `attempts` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `max_retries` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `retry_interval_minutes` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `next_attempt_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_event_delivery` (`event_id`,`notification_id`,`channel`,`recipient_hash`),
  KEY `idx_cl_workorder_notification_delivery_next_attempt_at` (`next_attempt_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `cl_workorder_notification_event` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `parent_event_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `notification_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `occurrence` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `repeat_count` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `repeat_minutes` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `instance_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `event_type` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `plan` longblob,
  `snapshot` longblob NOT NULL,
  `content` text,
  `sender_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `attempts` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `next_attempt_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `lease_token` varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `lease_until` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_error` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `idx_notification_occurrence` (`parent_event_id`,`notification_id`,`occurrence`),
  KEY `idx_cl_workorder_notification_event_parent_event_id` (`parent_event_id`),
  KEY `idx_cl_workorder_notification_event_instance_id` (`instance_id`),
  KEY `idx_cl_workorder_notification_event_status` (`status`),
  KEY `idx_cl_workorder_notification_event_next_attempt_at` (`next_attempt_at`),
  KEY `idx_cl_workorder_notification_event_lease_until` (`lease_until`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

CREATE TABLE `cl_workorder_notification_resolution` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `event_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `delivery_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `action` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `operator_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `reason` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_cl_workorder_notification_resolution_event_id` (`event_id`),
  KEY `idx_cl_workorder_notification_resolution_delivery_id` (`delivery_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

ALTER TABLE `cl_tree_cloud_account` ADD COLUMN `credential_type` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'long_term' AFTER `secret_key`, ADD COLUMN `session_token` text AFTER `credential_type`, ADD COLUMN `provider_credentials` text AFTER `session_token`, ADD COLUMN `credential_expires_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL AFTER `provider_credentials`, ADD COLUMN `credential_version` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' AFTER `credential_expires_at`
ALTER TABLE `cl_tree_cloud_account_region` ADD COLUMN `project_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '该地域对应的项目ID' AFTER `region_name`

ALTER TABLE `cl_tree_cloud_resource_sync_history` ADD COLUMN `region_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL AFTER `deleted_at`, ADD COLUMN `region` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL AFTER `region_id`, ADD COLUMN `operation_id` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL AFTER `region`, ADD COLUMN `lease_expires_ms` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' AFTER `operation_id`, ADD KEY `idx_cl_tree_cloud_resource_sync_history_operation_id` (`operation_id`), ADD KEY `idx_cl_tree_cloud_resource_sync_history_region_id` (`region_id`)

ALTER TABLE `cl_workorder_notification` ADD COLUMN `version` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' AFTER `deleted_at`, ADD COLUMN `trigger_version` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' AFTER `version`, ADD COLUMN `delay_minutes` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '延迟分钟' AFTER `scheduled_time`, ADD COLUMN `repeat_count` bigint DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '总发送次数' AFTER `repeat_interval`
